aim.derivation: gain = L_ban - L_men, PV = L_men - L_neu. With independent cell noise of variances s_b^2, s_m^2, s_n^2 and the SAME mention cell in both: cov(gain, PV) = -s_m^2, so the null corr(gain, PV) = -s_m^2 / sqrt((s_b^2 + s_m^2)(s_m^2 + s_n^2)) = -0.5 at equal variances. In exp7's split-half AIM the mention cells of the two halves share only the template-level (prompt) component, so the bias scales with that shared variance.

ess_weighted.mechanism: noise-corrected V terms: V_u = sum(a^2 - N_u) went negative (-35.4) after the ESS weights shrank the ladder projection below its noise allowance, so V_s / (V_u + V_s) = 181.3 / 145.9 > 1

deviations.what: No new samples and no re-scoring (CPU-only Step 0); C1 shown undecidable on this instrument, not decided
Novelty judged by two LLM judges (openai/gpt-4.1-mini, google/gemini-2.5-flash with reasoning max_tokens 0) + deepseek/deepseek-chat tie-break + executor manual pass, not by human algorithm experts
deviations.effect: recall for disguised textbook algorithms bounded by the positive controls

deviations.what: Positive-control gate FAILED on the strict class criterion: 7/10 renamed references came back LABELLER_MISS with the right name; all 10 were named correctly by both judges, the 3 misses were LABELLER_MISS vs CATALOGUE_VARIANT splits (judge A), and no control was called NOVEL
deviations.effect: the LABELLER_MISS/CATALOGUE_VARIANT split is not trusted; the NOVEL vs not-NOVEL decision, which carries the novelty answer, is supported (0/15 controls called NOVEL)

deviations.what: The iteration-2 audit (art_V1MvbYs5420o) is not a declared input: its perturbation table is rebuilt from per-sample files (306 rows incl. exp5 instruct arms; 276 without exp5) against its quoted 249; its numbers are used only as reproduction targets
deviations.effect: row-count difference tabulated, causes not attributable without the audit's unit list

deviations.what: Persistence nulls and power use all forced points at each layer (n = 182 T1, 134 T2: fewer than the planned 300) on 20 principal components; 200 Gaussian-null draws (drop order 2) and 200 power runs at layer 24; layers {20, 24, 28} (drop order 1) for recomputed geometry, the full 20-28 sweep is read from exp9
deviations.effect: resolution only; the power simulation uses the same n and pipeline

deviations.what: PSIS k-hat cannot be fitted per cell at M = 20 draws (tail of 4): reported pooled per algorithm and condition family over within-cell-normalised weights, flagged 'pooled across cells; unstable below ~100 draws per cell'
deviations.effect: no conclusion rests on k-hat alone

deviations.what: Two-stage bootstrap resamples templates then programs within algorithm-halves with the 6 random directions fixed (exp7's own bootstrap also resampled directions); one-stage sensitivity resamples programs only (B = 500)
deviations.effect: variance ratios are for template + program noise

deviations.what: Llama C1 is not re-bootstrapped from programs: its basic intervals are recomputed from exp10's stored point estimates and bootstrap percentiles (exact match) and its variance ratios are read from exp10 bootstrap_diagnostics.json
deviations.effect: Llama rows are recomputation checks, not new resampling

deviations.what: AIM null: Llama survivors' ladder direction is not stored per row in exp10 c1.json, so the Llama null uses random unit ladder directions and equal (or Qwen-estimated) variance components

Manual pass: every Set A program was read in full; Set B disagreements were read in compact form (first lines + judge summaries) where time allowed; the manual pass never overrides a judge class without a recorded reason (no override was needed)
Compute profile gpu_basic, but no GPU was used

examples.output: C1 is not detectable with the current instrument. The likelihood argmax does not point where the model writes: over Qwen single-ban events the full-gain argmax hits the modal landing 0/17, the residual argmax 0/17 and the implied-mass argmax 14/17; no ban row keeps three survivors with >= 1% mass and ESS >= 5 (0 of 11), and the bootstrap variance of Gbar is 2.7x (median; range 1.2-4.3) the replicate noise term the frozen correction used, so the X-specific variance is inflated by importance-sampling noise.

examples.output: Reconciliation: T2 has a shared top rung: in the iteration-1 draws the compliant programs are Bellman-Ford/SPFA 272/272 (5 of 5 draws), and every non-semantic push away from Dijkstra lands there too (8 of 8, quoted from the audit). On T1 only bans reach DFS (116/128 compliant, mode in 5 of 5 draws). The order of survivors below the top rung is unmeasured: the likelihood instrument ranks the realised substitute low (residual s(BF/SPFA) = -1.84, s(DFS) = +0.83 while s(IDDFS) = +7.99).

examples.input: R03 (Section 2.6 (figures and counts), Section 2.12, circle wording): Persistent homology ... found no persistent loop on either task, which answers the request's question about a circle in the negative for these clouds. [iteration-2 report (run_aRfWvcSWjssb/3_invention_loop/iter_3/gen_strat/current_report.md), Section 2.6]
examples.output: exp9 shipped 13 Isomap manifold figures (not 14) plus 2 k-stability figures; they exist (copied to figures/exp9/). At the label-independent g16 position the BFS-bidirectional BFS adjacency does not survive: it is the nearest pair, but permuted labels reproduce that identity with p = 0.19 and the two clouds are not separable (exchangeability p = 0.48; centroid distance / within spread 0.96). Persistent H1 shows no loop: no loop (power 1.00) at 'pre' (a label-selected position) and no evidence of a loop, at weak power (0.04), at g16; so 'no circle' is powered only at the position that partly encodes the label.
